Commentary.Commentary: Right then. The chase is set to begin. The Zimbabwe players have made their way out in the middle. Followed by Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das. Blessing Muzarabani to start with the new ball.

Right. Zimbabwe put up a good fight and marched onto end their innings at 298 for 10. So, Bangladesh need 299 runs to win to complete the whitewash. It is going to be a nail-biting chase. Anything can happen here. Do join us in a while, as the chase gets underway.

Bangladesh were on the backfoot since the beginning. Their pacers failed to trouble the opening pair. And then the skipper Iqbal decided to get some spin into the attack and they finally found a breakthrough via Shakib Al Hasan. It was an outing for the spinners early on in the day, as Mahmudullah struck twice to put Bangladesh in a comfortable spot. But then a couple of partnership stand frustrated the bowlers. After some effort bowling, the pacers were finally getting rewarded. Mustafizur Rahman was the first pacer to get on the wickets column. Followed by Taskin Ahmed, they both snared a wicket. Mohammad Saifuddin was the most expensive of the lot, he gave away 87 runs in 8 overs but in his final over, he picked up three wickets to rattle the tail-enders. While in the final over Mustafizur Rahman came back to take the final wicket of Zimbabwe.

A good day with the bat for Zimbabwe, they faced a few hiccups in the middle but in the end, came back stronger. The opening stand of Chakabva and Muramani started off well with good negotiation with the pacey bowling attack. But the latter struggled to do the same against the spin attack of Al Hasan. The skipper, Taylor today got out with an effortless shot and was departed back only for 28 runs.  Regis Chakabva stood out there for long, even got to 84, his personal best score in ODI but could not end the innings with three figures. Looked like he and Raza will see off the innings but it was not to be. But it was Burl instead who took the task on his shoulders and supported Raza solidly during the end overs. Their 112 runs stand helped reach Zimbabwe hover near the 300-run mark. But the tail-enders were not able to add few runs to cross 300 runs, as the hosts lost 4 wickets in the last two overs and end the innings at 298/10.

OUT! BOWLED! Mustafizur Rahman gets his third wicket! A slower length ball around middle and leg. Blessing Muzarabani looks to go big on the leg side but gets deceived by the pace of the ball and fails to get any bat on it. The ball rolls through and hits the stump. ZIMBABWE END AT 298.
WIDE! A length ball way down the leg side. Blessing Muzarabani leaves it alone. Wided.
Beautiful delivery! A yorker just around 4th stump. Blessing Muzarabani looks to heave it but misses it.
Full and around off. Jongwe pushes it to covers.
Who will come out next? It is going to be Blessing Muzarabani.

OUT! BOWLED! Zimbabwe are 9 down now and Mohammad Saifuddin gets his third wicket of the over. Another beautiful yorker around off. Chatara looks to dig it out but manages an inside edge onto the stumps.
Another good yorker on off. Jongwe digs it out to short third man for one.
A yorker length ball on off. Chatara digs it out to the off side and takes a single.
Who will come out next? It is Tendai Chatara.

OUT! TIMBER! Wow, Mohammad Saifuddin gets two wicket in a row. This is so surprising because he gave away the most runs in the lot but in the penultimate over, he was able to pick up two wicket to boost his confidence.Serves a full length ball, on off, Tiripano looks to push it away but misses. The ball goes onto shatter the stumps. Something to cheer about for Mohammad Saifuddin.
Who will come out next? It is Donald Tiripano.

Burl looks to latch onto it and power it over the long on fence but does not get the distance. Liton Das runs to his right and takes a sharp catch.

It is time for Powerplay 3! Now, maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle. Also, Shakib Al Hasan comes back into the attack for Bangladesh.

On off, pushed to cover for a single.

DRINKS! After getting a good start Zimbabwe are falling apart. From 149 for 3 to 178 for 5. Both the set batsman are gone. For Bangladesh, they are well back in this game. They are getting wickets in regular intervals and are surely on top at this moment
Who will come out next? It is Ryan Burl.

OUT! TIMBER! Regis Chakabva walks back after reaching his personal best. Taskin Ahmed is delighted, as he finally gets a wicket and that too of the well settled batsman. Chakabva just lost his concentration there. Not a great shot to respond with. Fires in a full length ball, on off. Chakabva plays all around it, as he looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes through and uproots the off stump on it's way. But instead, this should've been defended out with a dead bat. Regis Chakabva also loses his balance while playing the shot. A hard-working knock of Chakabva ends with a blunder.

FLatter ball again outside off. Raza cuts it but finds the point fielder.
Flatter ball outside off, Cut away straight to point.

The ball gets an extra bounce off the pitch. Chakabva stays back and upper cuts it over the third man for a maximum. He moves to 84, this is also his best score in ODI cricket.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length ball, on off. Chakabva stands back and looks to pull it away but misses.
A full length ball, on off. Raza drives it through cover for a single.

On a length, around off. Raza stays back and blocks it to point.
A length ball, on off, Raza defends it out solidly.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wesley Madhevere has to walk back to the shed in no time. This is brilliant by Mustafizur Rahman. This is what Bangladesh wanted, to chip early wickets of the new players who come in the middle. And for the first time in the day, a speedster has got into the wicket's column for Bangladesh. Serves a slower delivery, full and on the pads. Wesley Madhevere hangs his bat in defense but the ball lofts towards mid-wicket, where Shakib Al Hasan is well place. He cups his palms and takes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shakib Al Hasan b Mustafizur Rahman

A short ball, on off. Chakabva ducks under it.
A full length ball, on middle. Wesley Madhevere tucks it to the right of mid on for a single.

OUT! TIMBER! A good inning by Dion Myers comes to an end. Mahmudullah gets his second wicket of the innings. He is working his magic with the spin today, Filling the shoes nicely of Mehidy Hasan, the spin partner of Shakib Al Hasan. The ball was to full to be cut away and Myers fall. Loopy ball, full and on middle. Myers moves back and looks to cut it away but misses it completely. The ball goes onto shatter the stumps. A poor decision by Dion Myers costs him his wicket.
On middle, tucked to short fine leg.

Regis Chakabva and Dion Myers are batting with ease. They are not taking any risk but making sure the scoreboard is moving.

Dion Myers is not happy about it and stares down at the bowler, as he points his right hand to the stumps and asks the bowler to aim the stumps and not him.

DRINKS! Zimbabwe are looking good despite losing Marumani early on. Runs are not flowing but Taylor and Chakabva are trying to stitch a crucial partnership. For Bangladesh, they are executing their lines and lengths well. They are not giving away many runs but they need to continue picking up wickets before the pair ups the ante.

A short ball, on middle. Chakabva ducks under it. So 5 runs off the over.
Back of a length ball, on middle. Taylor pulls it to square leg and rotates the strike.
A full length delivery, on off. Taylor drives it straight to mid off.
A length ball, around off. Taylor moves across and defends it out.
FOUR! Makes the pick up shot look so easy. A full length ball, on off. Taylor lifts it over mid on and the ball takes a couple of bounces into the ropes. Moves to 9.
Good length ball, outside off. Taylor leaves it alone for the keeper.
A short ball on middle. Taylor steps across and pulls it to fine leg for another single.
A length ball on off. Taylor pushes it to cover.
A short of a length ball outside off. Taylor ramps it over the slip cordon towards third man for a couple of runs.
Another fuller ball on middle. Chakabva tucks it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball on middle. Taylor flicks it to the leg side for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Taylor blocks it out.
Done with Powerplay 1! Powerplay 2 begins. Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be allowed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over.
Full on middle, flicked to square leg for a single. Taylor is off the mark.
Beauty of a delivery! A good length ball angling across, outside off. Taylor is tempted to push this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good length ball on off. Taylor defends it under his eyes to point.
A full ball on middle. Taylor defends it on the leg side.
Tad fuller, slanting across, way outside off. Brendan Taylor leaves it alone.
On the pads, flicked to sqaure leg for a single.
Floated and on off. Taylor defends it out watchfully.
Tossed up and on off, Taylor prods and defends it out.
Brendan Taylor, the skipper, walks in at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Bangladesh finally gets the breakthrough and guess who, it is their main man Shakib Al Hasan who gives it. Al Hasan bowls a fuller ball on middle and leg. Tadiwanashe Marumani again goes for the paddle sweep but this time misses it completely. The ball sneaks through and hits him on the pads. Bangladesh appeal and the umpire instantly raises his finger.  Tadiwanashe Marumani goes back to the hut for 8 runs.
Fuller ball on middle. Tadiwanashe Marumani sweeps it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on middle. Regis Chakabva comes down the track and works it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, fuller on middle. Regis Chakabva nudges it to mid-wicket.
Shakib Al Hasan comes into the attack. So spin from both end now. He replaces Taskin Ahmed.

Appeal for LBW but turned down! A flatter, quicker ball on middle and leg. Tadiwanashe Marumani rocks back and looks to flick but misses it completely, gets hit on the pads. Bangladesh appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Flatter ball on middle. Tadiwanashe Marumani clips it to sqaure leg.
Loopy ball on middle, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball outside off. Regis Chakabva slaps it off the back foot to covers.
Tossed up on middle. Tadiwanashe Marumani pushes it to long on for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Mahmudullah comes into the attack to work his spin.
A good length ball on off. Regis Chakabva blocks it out.
TAP AND RUN! A full ball on middle. Pushed to mid off for a quick single.
A short ball on middle. Tadiwanashe Marumani ducks under it.
Easy pickings! On a length, on the pads. Chakabva clips it wide of square leg. The fielder runs across, dives and saves a run for his team.
Another length ball on off. Chakabva blocks it on the off side.
BEATEN! A good length ball just around off. Chakabva looks to defend inside the line but gets beaten on the outside edge to the keeper.
Drags his length back a bit, outside off. Tadiwanashe Marumani punches it to point. 9 runs coming of the over.
On a length, outside off. Tadiwanashe Marumani defends it to point.
On the pads, on a length, clipped to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another beautiful shot from Chakabva! A fuller length ball, slanting across, outside off. Regis Chakabva leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
A full ball, way outside off. Regis Chakabva shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! TIMING! Fullish length ball on middle. Regis Chakabva pushes it wide of mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase but in vain and the ball races to the fence.
Outside off, left alone by Tadiwanashe Marumani.

SIX! Off the top edge. Marumani gets off the mark with a maximum. A short ball, on off. Marumani looks to pull it away but the ball takes the outside edge and flies towards the third man region for a maximum.
A length ball, on off. Chakabva pushes it towards backward point for a single. He moves to 13.
On a length, around off, coming back in. Chakbava looks to defend it and gets an inside edge onto the pads. Taskin Ahmed made a half-appeal for LBW but the umpire was unmoved.
A full length ball, on off. Chakabva keeps it out solidly.
A full length ball, on off, Chakabva defends it to point.
Three dots on the trot! On a length, outside off. Marumani looks to defend it out but misses. Just 2 runs off the over. A great start for Mustafizur Rahman.

This is brilliant stuff from Mustafizur Rahman. Serves it on a fullish length, around off. Marumani looks to push it out but misses. He hangs his bat out in defense, but the ball holds the line and beats the outside edge.
BEATEN! What a beauty. On a length, outside off. The ball hold it's line after pitching. Marumani looks to defend it out, but misses. The ball goes straight into the keeper's mitts.
WIDE! A good length ball, outside off, swinging away. Marumani does not chase it. Umpire signals it as a wide.
On a length, outside off, with a little bit of an away movement. Marumani lets it go through to the keeper.
PLAY  AND A MISS! Good length ball, outside off. Marumani looks to push it away but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
A full length ball, on the pads. Chakabva flicks it through sqaure leg for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack now. He replaces Mohammad Saifuddin.
Outside off, left alone by Tadiwanashe Marumani.

Big appeal for caught behind but the umpire just shakes his head. There was some noise there. Serves a length delivery, outside off. Marumani looks to defend it out but misses. The ball beats the outside edge and into the keeper's mitts. Taskin Ahmed was on the verge of celebration but it was cut short by the umpire. The sound that came was because the bat hit the back pad, as shown in the replay.
A touch fuller,  on off. Chakabva pushes it to point and takes off for a single.
A full length ball, on off. Chakabva defends it back to the bowler.

A touch short, outside off. Chakabva again went after it looking for the connection. But this he just swings his bat hard and the ball goes through to the keeper. He was tempted by the width yet again.
On a length, around off, moving away a bit. Regis Chakabva stands tall and looks to pull it away but misses.
On a length, on middle. Chakabva tucks it to mid on and takes off for a single. He keeps the strike. 9 runs off the over.
A good length ball, on off. Chakabva defends it to cover off the outter half.
FOUR! Nicely played. A length ball, outside off. Chakabva hangs back and pushes it through the cover region for a boundary.
Back of a  length ball, on off. Regis Chakabva stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
A touch short, outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to go after it but misses.
FOUR! Lovely wrist work by Chakabva. A full length ball, on the pads. Regis Chakabva stays back and flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is going to be Mohammad Saifuddin.
Zimbabwe and Regis Chakabva are off the mark! A back of a length ball on middle. Chakabva tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball on middle. Regis Chakabva blocks it out.
Touch fuller, way outside off. Chakabva leaves it to the keeper.
Another good length ball, outside off, jags back in. Chakabva leaves it to the keeper.
A good length ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva shoulders arms to it.
Ahmed starts with a length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva pushes it to covers.
The Bangladesh players have made their way out in the middle. Followed by Regis Chakabva and Tadiwanashe Marumani who come out to bat. Taskin Ahmed to start with the ball.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Tadiwanashe Marumani, Brendan Taylor (C), Dion Myers, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl (IN PLACE OF RICHARD NGARAVA), Donald Tiripano (IN PLACE OF TINASHE KAMUNHUKAMWE), Luke Jongwe, Tendai Chatara, Blessing Muzarabani.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das (WK), Shakib Al Hasan, Mohammad Mithun, Mahmudullah, Nurul Hasan (IN PLACE OF SHORIFUL ISLAM), Afif Hossain, Mosaddek Hossain, Mohammad Saifuddin, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman (IN PLACE OF MEHIDY HASAN).
TOSS - The coin goes up and it lands in the favour of Bangladesh. They have decided to bowl first.

Hello and warm welcome to our coverage of the third and final ODI game between Zimbabwe and Bangladesh. The tourist side has already sealed the series with a 2-0 lead. They will look to continue their domination over the hosts and complete the whitewash. Currently, the tourists are seated on the second spot with 70 points in the World Cup Super League standings. While, Zimbabwe would look forward to end the series on a winning note and add some crucial points to the World Cup Super League table. Can they spare themselves from the clean sweep? We will have to wait and find out. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
